v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Tradétur enim géntibus * ad illudéndum, et flagellándum, et crucifigéndum.
text.en: For He shall be delivered to the Gentiles, * to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify.

text.la: Deus, innocéntiæ restitútor et amátor, dírige ad te tuórum corda servórum: ut, spíritus tui fervóre concépto, et in fide inveniántur stábiles, et in ópere efficáces.
text.en: God, the Renewer and Lover of innocency, turn the hearts of all thy servants to thyself, that so they, being enkindled with the fire of thy Spirit, may be found ever rooted in faith, and fruitful in works.

office.title: Feria Quarta infra Hebd II in Quadr
